before: The review rail listed comments and tracked changes as cards, and collapsed comment markers drew the comment icon. Only format and structural changes opened a page balloon. A review column that did not fit beside the page collapsed to a marker strip, and an open review or navigation pane shrank a capped fit.
after: Review pane settings revisionsIn, commentMarkers, and overflow ('float', 'shrinkPage', or 'scroll') choose whether tracked changes are rail cards or page balloons, how collapsed comment markers look, and whether a review column that does not fit keeps the page size and scrolls sideways. getActiveReviewItem and useReview().explicitActiveKey read whether the active review item was opened explicitly. A change balloon follows its text after repaints, and keeps a reply draft with a notice when another participant resolves the change. The comment reply box draws as a compact reply line.
reason: All review pane settings are local view state of one editor instance, never written to the document or shared with other participants; overflow changes only the local scroller padding and fit measurement. getActiveReviewItem is a read. Accept, reject, and reply from the balloon call the existing acceptReviewItem, rejectReviewItem, and replyToReviewItem paths, which two-participant tests cover for synchronization, undo, redo, rejoin, and concurrent edits. A two-participant test covers a remote accept and a remote reject while a balloon is open.
